analysis.method: Sum daily PRECTOTCORR for selected months. Exclude 29 February in all years. Compare target total with arithmetic mean of 30 complete same-season totals (1991–2020). Do not impute missing values.
analysis.limits: Gridded reanalysis at approximately 0.5° latitude × 0.625° longitude; not a local rain gauge. The result tests this rainfall claim only, not drought, flooding, water availability, causation or climate change attribution.
